BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 492,277 of its own ordinary shares between June 1st and June 5th, 2026, with prices ranging from 64.90 pence to 67.30 pence per share. These repurchased shares will be cancelled. Following these transactions, the company's issued ordinary share capital stands at 348,374,866 shares, with 4,169,756 held in treasury, leaving 344,205,110 shares available for shareholders to use as a denominator for regulatory notifications. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 08 June 2026 8 June 2026 'Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 01 June 2026 02 June 2026 03 June 2026 04 June 2026 05 June 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 114,232 120,701 117,861 60,892 90,583 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 67.30 67.10 66.40 65.7 67.10 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 65.50 64.90 65.30 64.90 65.00 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 66.2469 66.2142 65.8916 65.2723 66.5690 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 348,374,866 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 4,169,756 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 344,205,110 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. This disclosure is made pursuant to paragraph 9.6.6(R) of the Listing Rules. The table below contains detailed information about the purchases made as part of the Share repurchase programme.
